outgoing.name: Basil
outgoing.excerpt: The mint family, Lamiaceae, includes many other aromatic herbs, including most of the more common cooking herbs, including basil, rosemary, sage, oregano, and catnip.

outgoing.name: Food
outgoing.excerpt: Mint essential oils are used to flavor food, candy, teas, breath fresheners, antiseptic mouth rinses, and toothpaste.

outgoing.name: Fruit
outgoing.excerpt: The fruit is a small dry capsule containing 1-4 seeds.

outgoing.name: Greek mythology
outgoing.excerpt: According to Greek mythology, the plant was named after Minthe.

outgoing.name: Invasive species
outgoing.excerpt: They can be highly invasive plants, so caution should be taken in cultivation or it can take over an entire garden.
